title: Share one bean instance
summary: Spring Framework: Share one bean instance. Compare a separately created new Object too.
introduction: The normal Spring scope is singleton: one instance per bean definition in the container.
learningObjectives: Share one bean instance with Spring Framework
Compare a separately created new Object too

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Share one bean instance

blocks.text: The default scope returns the same Object on both lookups. Reference equality is therefore true.
Compare a separately created new Object too.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Singleton means one per container bean definition, not one in every program everywhere.
